definitions.gloss: memorial toast; offering a drink in memory of the deceased
definitions.explanation: A solemn toast made at funeral gatherings or memorial services to honor someone who has passed away. Unlike a celebratory toast, it is quiet and respectful.

examples.japanese: ⟦{故人|こじん}→故人：02807_kojin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{献杯|けんぱい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We made a memorial toast for the deceased.
Now then, a toast in their memory.
examples.notes: Said solemnly at a memorial gathering

examples.japanese: ⟦{法事|ほうじ}→法事：05634_houji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{席|せき}→席：02215_seki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{長男|ちょうなん}→長男：14519_chounan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{献杯|けんぱい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{挨拶|あいさつ}→挨拶：02505_aisatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{述|の}べた→述べる：02389_noberu⟧。
examples.english: At the memorial service, the eldest son gave the memorial toast address.

notes:
USAGE:
Important to distinguish from ⟦{乾杯|かんぱい}→乾杯：00176_kanpai⟧ (celebratory toast). At funerals and memorial services, one says {献杯|けんぱい}, not ⟦{乾杯|かんぱい}→乾杯：00176_kanpai⟧. The glasses are raised quietly without clinking, and the tone is solemn rather than festive.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {献杯|けんぱい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{挨拶|あいさつ}→挨拶：02505_aisatsu⟧ (memorial toast address)
- {献杯|けんぱい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{音頭|おんど}→音頭：09782_ondo⟧ (leading the memorial toast)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{乾杯|かんぱい}→乾杯：00176_kanpai⟧: cheers, toast — celebratory; never used at funerals
